content:
tar -xvzf libpcap-1.9.1.tar.gz
cd libpcap-1.9.1
./configure --disable-shared
make -j$(nproc)
make install
cd ..
cd json-c
mkdir build
cd build
cmake -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF ..
make install
cd ../..
cd ndpi
sh autogen.sh
./configure --enable-fuzztargets
make
ls fuzz/fuzz* | grep -v "\." | grep -v "with_main" | while read i; do cp $i $OUT/; done
